synopsis: Project Chrono and Chrono::Vehicle provide multibody and multiphysics dynamics for wheeled, tracked and articulated vehicles [f8493]. Across the job-site and tools chapters, Chrono::Vehicle supports rigid and deformable terrain, including semi-empirical SCM Bekker-Wong, granular discrete-element models and continuum models; the tools chapter identifies the continuum option as CRM continuum SPH [f3961, f8494]. Its documentation says deformable terrain relies on collision and contact, rather than a friction value painted onto a visual surface [f3962]. Project Chrono and Chrono::Vehicle are open-source tools licensed under BSD-3, but are not a turnkey test-management product [f8492, f8501].

relations.note: Both describe rigid and deformable terrain with SCM, discrete-element and continuum models.
Explains the collision-and-contact basis of the listed deformable terrain capabilities.
Clarifies that deformable terrain is physical contact modeling, not painted surface friction.
Adds terrain-model capabilities to the broader vehicle dynamics scope.
